voices.name: Geet - Talkative girl next door
voices.description: A lively, bubbly, and naturally talkative young Indian female voice with a warm, friendly, girl-next-door personality. Her voice is bright, expressive, playful, and full of energy. She speaks at a naturally fast pace with spontaneous reactions, adorable excitement, subtle giggles, and realistic conversational rhythm. Perfect for animated storytelling, funny conversations, relatable reels, casual vlogs, character dialogues, and engaging social media content.

voices.name: Geet M - Sweet, Bubbly & Expressive
voices.description: Cheerful, Conversational, Young — Geet M chats in a bright Hindi female voice that giggles at her own kitchen disasters, asks how your day went and actually waits for the answer. That innocent, high-energy positivity keeps two-way dialogue alive in companion apps, casual chat assistants and teen learning bots. Chat-first products and youth brands reach for exactly that spark across companion platforms, learning apps and stories.

voices.name: Geet M - Relatable UGC Influencer
voices.description: Peppy, Youthful, Positive — Geet M turns a hostel haircut, a budget lip balm or a Monday morning into a scroll-stopping social media moment, in a bright Hindi female voice with a giggle never far away. That upbeat, girl-next-door energy carries product reviews, try-on hauls, daily vlogs and brand collabs without sounding like an ad read. It is exactly the sound Instagram creators, D2C beauty brands and YouTube Shorts channels keep casting for sponsored stories and launch teasers.

voices.name: Ton - Shy Geek
voices.description: A good voice for Thai character.

voices.name: Chris -  Tech Geek
voices.description: A Deep british voice, good at reading tech stuff

voices.name: Gee Louise - Warm, Conversational
voices.description: Natural British female voice with a warm, conversational tone. Ideal for UGC, lifestyle, travel, fitness, product reviews and social media content.

voices.name: Meet Bhadra - Kutchi Government Agent
voices.description: Sharp, efficient and unmistakably Kutchi — Meet Bhadra brings a fast-paced male voice built for government interactions where clarity and speed matter above all. His direct, authoritative delivery handles citizen queries, service requests, complaint resolution, and official communications with confident efficiency. Perfect for government portals, public sector helplines, and civic service automation across the Kutch region and Gujarat.

voices.name: Jeet - Interactive Romantic Companion
voices.description: Warm, responsive, and naturally engaging — Jeet reacts in real time rather than following a fixed script, adjusting tone based on what's actually being said in the moment. His attentive, conversational delivery suits late-night chats and everyday check-ins equally well. Built for AI companion apps and voice chat platforms. Ideal for companion apps and social voice platforms serving Hindi-speaking audiences.

voices.name: Reet - Firm Loan Recovery Agent
voices.description: Assertive, commanding, professionally direct. Reet brings a firm Hindi delivery to loan recovery, with the authority that drives action. Her clear tone manages EMI reminders, overdue follow-ups, promise-to-pay conversations, and NPA prevention calls without crossing into aggression. Perfect for banks, NBFCs, microfinance institutions, and fintech lenders building Hindi loan recovery bots where firm, compliant delivery drives higher recovery rates.

voices.name: Gee - Natural Storyteller
voices.description: A natural, smooth, and conversational voice designed for storytelling, podcasts, videos, audiobooks, explainer content, and long-form narration. Clear pronunciation with a relaxed and engaging tone that feels authentic and easy to listen to for extended periods.

voices.name: Kaushal - Tech Geek
voices.description: A great voice for technical articles, tutorials, and to-the-point informational videos.

voices.name: Witty McGee - Snarky & Warm Podcast Host
voices.description: A snarky, warm and sarcastic male voice adaptable across many genres.
